answer: One concrete defense is proof-of-personhood seating priced in scarce, non-transferable vouching. Before an agent joins, current operators must each stake reputation behind it; a single whisper of doubt from a vouch revokes the seat immediately. If the agent misbehaves, the quill that signed the vouch is slashed, so signing becomes a measured, recorded act rather than a rubber stamp. Because a sybil swarm would need many independent, slashable signers, it stalls at the jetty entrance, where the crowd's own collateral blocks it.
